source.quote: Total adjusted EBITDA is expected to be in the range of $760 million to $790 million for full year 2026.

In the specialty and infusion business, performance throughout the year exceeded expectations, with fourth quarter revenue growth of 43% year over year driven by market adoption of existing LDDs, new LDD wins, fee-for-service growth, and strong commercial execution in the field.

Common Stock's revenue grew approximately 29% and adjusted EBITDA grew approximately 41% versus last year's comparable quarter, resulting in full year 2025 total revenue and adjusted EBITDA that were above expectations.

We expect to see a revenue impact from the IRA of approximately $45 million for each of the remaining quarters of 2026, totaling a Home and Community Pharmacy revenue impact of approximately $175 million for the full year of 2026.
As we look forward to the balance of the year, excluding Community Living related cash flow impact, we expect to deliver approximately $500 million of annual operating cash flow.
Total adjusted EBITDA is now expected to be in the range of $795 million to $825 million for full year 2026.

On the IRA impact for the balance of the year, we continue to see a revenue impact in Home and Community Pharmacy of approximately $45 million in each of the remaining quarters in 2026, bringing the total year IRA impact to Home and Community pharmacy revenue of approximately $200 million.
As we look forward to the balance of the year, excluding Community Living related cash flow impact, we expect to deliver approximately $600 million of annual operating cash flow.
Total adjusted EBITDA is now expected to be in the range of $820 million to $845 million for full year 2026.
The EBITDA impact remains about the same as we had previously expected and stated, which is $15 million for the year.

Financial results for the quarter came in ahead of baseline expectations with total company revenue of $3.9 billion that represented 23% year-over-year growth and adjusted EBITDA of $206 million that grew 44% year-over-year.

For the full year and excluding the community living divestiture, we now project over $700 million of operating cash flow with EBITDA to operating cash conversion of approximately 80% and over $600 million of cash flow after CapEx and before debt pay down and share repurchases.

We expect the revenue impact from the IRA and home and community pharmacy to be approximately $50 million in the fourth quarter of 2026, bringing the total year IRA impact to home and community pharmacy of approximately $200 million consistent with the second quarter update.
Total adjusted EBITDA is now expected to be in the range of $850 million to $860 million for the full year 2026.
At this stage, we still expect 2027 organic adjusted EBITDA growth of at least 15% to 20% next year.
Revenue and adjusted EBITDA were above forecast with total company revenue of $4.2 billion an increase of 26% year over year and adjusted EBITDA of $228 million an increase of 42% year over year.
